Hi Lisa — thanks for the note.

Short answers up front:
- We can provide the full SOC 2 Type II report under a countersigned NDA.
- Our most recent Type II covers the audit period 2026-09-01 to 2027-08-31.
- Countersign turnaround is typically 48 hours once we receive an executed DocuSign request; if legal review is needed on redlines, plan for up to 5 business days.

Requesting a couple quick clarifications so we can scope delivery:
1) Who will need access to the gated report (names + emails)? We typically grant view-only access through our secure evidence portal to named reviewers and require SSO or short-lived link.
2) Do you require a bridge letter in lieu of the full report (sometimes customers request that if their window overlaps our audit but they don't want the full report)? We can produce either.

Attached: our internal checklist for gated deliveries and a suggested DocuSign envelope we can initiate if you confirm reviewers.

Next steps we propose:
- You send the Oakmont NDA via DocuSign OR confirm you accept Redwood's standard countersign (I can initiate).
- Provide list of reviewers and preferred email addresses.
- We'll countersign and provision access to your reviewers.

Camila Reyes
